the_blocking_finding_is_true.read_against_the_bytes: TRUE. README.md lines 141-146 (runs/transactions/.../06eca5c.../README.md) carry two adjacent, distinct sentences both pointing the reader at the same examples directory: line 141-143 'Runnable scripts are available in the `examples` directory (`all_symbologies.py`, `render_options.py`, `error_handling.py`, `quickstart.py`). Additional worked examples cover the generic entry point and per-symbology encoding options below.' and line 145-146 'Runnable example scripts and what each one demonstrates are listed in `examples/README.md`.' Both are genuine, SUPPORTED, maintainer-authored sentences (facts.json: inherited_unit:026.paragraph, originally under the source README's own 'Additional Examples' heading, lines 110-112; inherited_unit:057.paragraph, originally under the source README's own 'Development and Testing' heading, lines 257-258) - neither is invented, but placing both in the same rendered section is a genuine content duplication a reader would notice.
the_blocking_finding_is_true.root_cause_is_reconciliation_not_authori: dispositions.json disposes inherited_unit:026.paragraph VERIFIED_PRESERVE, destination_section additional_examples (correct - this is its original section) and inherited_unit:057.paragraph VERIFIED_MOVE, destination_section additional_examples, rationale 'The paragraph about example scripts is preserved and moved to the additional_examples section, which is rendered from facts.' S4 reconciliation moved a paragraph out of its own original section (development_testing) into a section that already had an equivalent maintainer sentence about the same subject, creating the duplication F05 correctly names. Neither content_units.json's authored 'units' array nor the renderer's own template strings contain either sentence (grepped: no match for either sentence's text anywhere under src/) - both are rendered verbatim from VERIFIED_PRESERVE/VERIFIED_MOVE dispositions, a path repair cannot reach (grepped: no match for VERIFIED_MOVE or VERIFIED_PRESERVE anywhere under src/repository_presenter/components/readme/repair/).

Round 2 re-raised the identical finding because the candidate's rendered bytes had not moved at all - confirmed by comparing content_units.json's additional_examples units across both rounds (identical) and README.md lines 141-146 (unchanged).
